description: 小作文各题型写作框架模板

paragraph_1.purpose: 自我介绍 + 写信目的
paragraph_1.template:
Dear ...,

    I am [身份]. I am writing to offer some suggestions regarding [话题].

paragraph_2.template: First and foremost, I would suggest that ... In addition, it might be beneficial to ... Last but not least, you may also consider ...

paragraph_3.purpose: 表达期望 + 礼貌结尾
paragraph_3.template:
I hope these suggestions will be of help to you. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

key_expressions: I would like to suggest that ...
It is advisable to ...
My recommendation would be ...

paragraph_1.purpose: 写信目的——邀请参加某活动
paragraph_1.template:
Dear ...,

    I am writing to invite you to [活动]. The event will be held [时间地点].

paragraph_2.purpose: 活动详情（时间、地点、内容）
paragraph_2.template: The [活动] will take place at [地点] on [日期]. During the event, there will be [活动内容]. I believe you will find it [有趣/有意义].

paragraph_3.purpose: 再次表达邀请 + 期待回复
paragraph_3.template:
I sincerely hope that you can make it. Please let me know your decision at your earliest convenience.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

key_expressions: It would be a great honor if you could ...
You are cordially invited to ...
We would be delighted to have you ...

paragraph_1.template:
Dear ...,

    I am writing to express my sincere/heartfelt gratitude for [感谢的事情].

paragraph_2.purpose: 具体说明感谢的原因或回忆细节
paragraph_2.template: Thanks to your [帮助/建议], I was able to [收获/成就]. Your kindness and generosity have left a deep impression on me.

paragraph_3.purpose: 再次感谢 + 期待未来交往
paragraph_3.template:
Once again, I would like to express my sincere appreciation. I hope we can keep in touch.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

key_expressions: I am extremely grateful to you for ...
I truly appreciate your ...
Words cannot express how thankful I am.

paragraph_1.template:
Dear ...,

    I am terribly sorry to inform you that I am unable to [原定计划]. I owe you an apology.

paragraph_2.purpose: 解释原因 + 提出补救措施
paragraph_2.template: The reason is that [原因]. To make up for it, I would like to [补救方案].

paragraph_3.purpose: 再次道歉 + 请求理解
paragraph_3.template:
I sincerely hope you can accept my apology. I promise this will not happen again.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

key_expressions: I sincerely apologize for ...
Please accept my heartfelt apology.
I assure you this will not happen again.

paragraph_1.template:
Dear Sir or Madam,

    I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with [投诉对象] which I purchased/experienced on [日期].

paragraph_2.template: The problem is that [具体问题1]. Moreover, [具体问题2]. This has caused me great inconvenience.

paragraph_3.purpose: 提出解决方案 + 期待回复
paragraph_3.template:
I would appreciate it if you could [期望的解决方式]. I look forward to your prompt reply.

Yours faithfully,
Li Ming

key_expressions: I demand a full refund/replacement.
I trust you will take this matter seriously.
Unless the issue is resolved, I will ...

paragraph_1.template:
Dear ...,

    I was delighted/thrilled to hear that you [被祝贺的事情]. Congratulations!

paragraph_2.purpose: 具体祝贺内容 + 给出建议或鼓励
paragraph_2.template: You truly deserve this achievement. I believe it is the result of your hard work and dedication. Here are a few suggestions for [下一步]...

paragraph_3.template:
Once again, congratulations! I wish you all the best in your future endeavors.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

key_expressions: Please accept my warmest congratulations on ...
You truly deserve this honor.
I am so proud of you.

paragraph_1.template:
Dear ...,

    I am writing to recommend [推荐对象] to you.

paragraph_2.purpose: 详细介绍推荐对象的优点/特色
paragraph_2.template: First, [优点1]. Moreover, [优点2]. What's more, [优点3].

paragraph_3.template:
I am confident that [推荐对象] will be an excellent choice. I hope my recommendation is helpful.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

key_expressions: I have no hesitation in recommending ...
I am confident that ... will not disappoint you.
... is highly qualified for ...

paragraph_1.purpose: 自我介绍 + 说明询问目的
paragraph_1.template:
Dear ...,

    I am [身份]. I am writing to inquire about [询问主题].

paragraph_2.template: I would like to know [问题1]. In addition, could you please inform me about [问题2]? I am also wondering [问题3].

paragraph_3.template:
I would appreciate it if you could reply at your earliest convenience. Thank you for your time.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

key_expressions: I would be grateful if you could provide ...
Could you please inform me of ...?
I am particularly interested in ...

paragraph_1.template: In order to [目的], [组织] is going to hold/organize [活动]. The details are as follows.

paragraph_2.purpose: 具体安排（时间、地点、活动内容）
paragraph_2.template: The event will take place at [地点] on [日期] from [时间] to [时间]. The main activities include [内容1] and [内容2].

paragraph_3.purpose: 参与方式 + 联系方式
paragraph_3.template:
Those who are interested are requested to sign up at [方式] before [截止日期]. For more information, please contact [联系方式].

The Student Union
[日期]

key_expressions: All students are welcome to participate.
Your participation is highly expected.
Please be informed that ...
format_notes: 末尾署名单位 + 日期
